## `cidx xray explore`

Usage: `cidx xray explore [OPTIONS]`

```text
Explore AST node breakdowns for matches without running an evaluator.

Runs the same two-phase X-Ray search as ``xray search`` but includes a
verbose AST subtree below each match to help iterate on evaluator
expressions.

Exit codes:
  0  -- success, all files evaluated.
  2  -- usage / validation error.
  3  -- partial result (timeout or max-files cap reached).
```

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--repo` | text |  | yes | Local path to repository to search. |
| `--regex` | text |  | yes | Phase 1 regex driver applied to files. |
| `--eval` | text |  | no | Phase 2 Python evaluator code (inline). Mutually exclusive with --eval-file. |
| `--eval-file` | file |  | no | Path to a file containing Phase 2 Python evaluator code. Mutually exclusive with --eval. |
| `--target` | choice: `content`, `filename` | `content` | no | What Phase 1 regex applies to: file content or filename. |
| `--include` | text (repeatable) |  | no | Glob patterns to include (repeatable). Empty = include all. |
| `--exclude` | text (repeatable) |  | no | Glob patterns to exclude (repeatable). |
| `--timeout` | integer | `120` | no | Wall-clock cap in seconds (10-600). |
| `--max-files` | integer |  | no | Cap number of files evaluated. Reaching cap exits 3 and marks PARTIAL. |
| `--max-debug-nodes` | integer range (`>=1`, `<=500`) | `50` | no | Maximum AST nodes per match in AST debug output (1-500). |
| `--json` | flag |  | no | Emit JSON instead of formatted output. |
| `--quiet` | flag |  | no | Suppress progress output to stderr. Table/JSON still goes to stdout. |

## `cidx xray search`

Usage: `cidx xray search [OPTIONS]`

```text
Run a two-phase X-Ray search synchronously and print results.

Phase 1: regex driver selects candidate files (by content or filename).
Phase 2: Python evaluator runs against each candidate's AST.

Exit codes:
  0  -- success, all files evaluated.
  2  -- usage / validation error.
  3  -- partial result (timeout or max-files cap reached).
```

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|--------|------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `--repo` | text |  | yes | Local path to repository to search. |
| `--regex` | text |  | yes | Phase 1 regex driver applied to files. |
| `--eval` | text |  | no | Phase 2 Python evaluator code (inline). Mutually exclusive with --eval-file. |
| `--eval-file` | file |  | no | Path to a file containing Phase 2 Python evaluator code. Mutually exclusive with --eval. |
| `--target` | choice: `content`, `filename` | `content` | no | What Phase 1 regex applies to: file content or filename. |
| `--include` | text (repeatable) |  | no | Glob patterns to include (repeatable). Empty = include all. |
| `--exclude` | text (repeatable) |  | no | Glob patterns to exclude (repeatable). |
| `--timeout` | integer | `120` | no | Wall-clock cap in seconds (10-600). |
| `--max-files` | integer |  | no | Cap number of files evaluated. Reaching cap exits 3 and marks PARTIAL. |
| `--json` | flag |  | no | Emit JSON instead of a formatted table. |
| `--quiet` | flag |  | no | Suppress progress output to stderr. Table/JSON still goes to stdout. |
